get_encoder_from_files: load a GPT-2 BPE encoder from an encoder JSON and vocab BPE file path
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a string of text into a list of GPT-2 BPE token integers
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of GPT-2 BPE token integers back into a string of text
apply_bpe_merges: apply byte pair encoding merges to a token string using the encoder BPE ranks
bytes_to_unicode_mapping: generate a mapping from UTF-8 byte values to Unicode characters for BPE encoding
